title: Static DFT and harmonic phonon calculations
action: Using Quantum ESPRESSO with the PBE functional, perform static DFT calculations and harmonic phonon calculations on the Pv and PPv crystal structures to obtain equilibrium geometries, static energies, harmonic phonon frequencies and polarization vectors at sufficient k-point and q-point sampling.
description: Required intermediate to obtain harmonic reference data for mode projection and zero-point energies.

title: AIMD simulations
action: Run ab initio molecular dynamics (NVT ensemble) for 160-atom Pv and 180-atom PPv supercells at a set of volumes and temperatures spanning lower mantle conditions (e.g., 5 volumes, 6 temperatures between 300–5000 K) using the PBE functional and a Gamma-point k-point sampling. Generate atomic velocity trajectories.
description: Generates the velocity trajectories needed by the PHQ analysis.

title: PHQ analysis and Helmholtz free energy surfaces
action: For each (V,T) condition, compute mode-projected velocity autocorrelation functions using harmonic polarization vectors, fit renormalised phonon frequencies. Perform Fourier interpolation onto a dense q-mesh (to approach the thermodynamic limit), compute vibrational entropy via the phonon gas model, and integrate to obtain anharmonic Helmholtz free energy surfaces F(V,T) for both Pv and PPv.
description: Core of the PHQ method; produces the F(V,T) functions needed for all downstream properties.

title: Anharmonic thermodynamic properties at 4000 K
action: From the PHQ F(V,T) surfaces, derive the isothermal equation of state at 4000 K. Compute thermal expansivity (α), isothermal bulk modulus (K_T), adiabatic bulk modulus (K_S), isochoric heat capacity (C_V), isobaric heat capacity (C_P), and thermodynamic Grüneisen parameter (γ) at 4000 K and pressures 30, 60, 90, 120 GPa for both Pv and PPv. Write the results to thermodynamic_properties.csv.
description: CSV with one row per (phase, pressure) at T=4000 K for the four specified pressures. Includes both isothermal and adiabatic moduli, and both isochoric and isobaric heat capacities.
output_schema: Columns: phase (string), temperature_K (float, always 4000), pressure_GPa (float), thermal_expansivity_1_per_K (float), isothermal_bulk_modulus_GPa (float), adiabatic_bulk_modulus_GPa (float), isochoric_heat_capacity_J_per_mol_per_K (float), isobaric_heat_capacity_J_per_mol_per_K (float), thermodynamic_Gruneisen_parameter (float).

title: Pv-PPv phase boundary: transition pressure, Clapeyron slope, and CMB transition temperature
action: Convert the PHQ Helmholtz free energies to Gibbs free energy G = F + PV. At T = 2500 K, locate the pressure where G_Pv = G_PPv; this is the transition pressure. Compute the Clapeyron slope dP/dT at 2500 K by evaluating the transition pressure at two closely spaced temperatures. Also determine the transition temperature at the core-mantle boundary (CMB, 135 GPa) by finding where G_Pv = G_PPv at that pressure. Write the results to phase_boundary_results.json.
description: JSON with the PBE-PHQ transition pressure, Clapeyron slope at 2500 K, and CMB transition temperature. Optional additional slopes may be included.
